messages.subject: Basic Poisson Factorization...
parts:
Hi all,

I'm a Stan beginner trying to run the following basic model (Poisson factorization with missing data) but got stucked in the first call to poisson_log. 

I'm using PyStan (version 2.9.0.0). 

Here's the code and error message:

pfmodel = """
data {
    int<lower=0> U;  // number of Users
    int<lower=0> I;  // number of Items
    int<lower=0> K;  // number of latent dimensions
   
    int N;  // number of observed userItem pairs
    int jj[N];
    int kk[N];
    int<lower=0> y[N];
   
    real<lower=0> a;
    real<lower=0> b;
    real<lower=0> c;
    real<lower=0> d;
}


parameters {
    vector<lower=0>[K] theta[U];
    vector<lower=0>[K] beta[I];
}


model {
    for (u in 1:U){
        theta[u] ~ gamma(a,b);
    }
    for (i in 1:I){
        beta[i] ~ gamma(c,d);
    }
    for(n in 1:N) {
        increment_log_prob(poisson_log(y[n],theta[jj[n]]',beta[kk[n]]));
    }
}
"""

dat = {'K': 40, 'U':2321, 'I':5596, 'N':105764, 'a':9, 'b':0.5, 'c':9, 'd':0.5, 'jj':rows, 'kk':cols, 'y':c}


First in the output I have many many times this warning message:

Informational Message: The current Metropolis proposal is about to be rejected because of the following issue:
Exception thrown at line 34: []: accessing element out of range. index 0 out of range; expecting index to be between 1 and 2321; index position = 1theta
If this warning occurs sporadically, such as for highly constrained variable types like covariance matrices, then the sampler is fine,
but if this warning occurs often then your model may be either severely ill-conditioned or misspecified.


Rejecting initial value:
  Error evaluating the log probability at the initial value.

And finally the real error :

Initialization between (--2, -2) failed after 100 attempts.
 Try specifying initial values, reducing ranges of constrained values, or reparameterizing the model.

The model is pretty simple, but I don't understand the "Exception thrown at line 34" and the "Initialization problem" as well.

Any help is welcome !

Thanks all !

JB

messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Error evaluating the log probability at the initial value
parts: Exception thrown at line 34: []: accessing element out of range. index 0 out of range; expecting index to be between 1 and 2321; index position = 1theta
At line 34 you’re trying to call theta[jj[n]] with jj[n] = 0 or beta[kk[n]] with kk[n] = 0. Stan in 1-indexed.
